RI-AUD03 names the AR-2 risk explicitly: Souls-style near-total silence outside boss arenas, so the world reads as a mausoleum. All thirteen exteriors render audible PCM at -24 to -34 LUFS-I and separate 78/78 on a level-normalised spectrum. The world is loud where it should be loud.

absence is implemented as content, not omission: stone-wastes declares L2 null, deep-marshes' L3 sits at [30,40], and the two tier-5 regions are measurably the two quietest (-28.0 and -34.0). That is RI-AUD03's absence-is-a-layer rule and AR-3 seam #3 (silence as a lethality cue) carried in measured sound.

NOT stretched to cover the interior silence. Every interior and settlement cell is silent (115 interiors; helstrom-market and stormhold-street both suppress), but that is R4 debt honestly declared, not a Souls convention contaminating the world. S26 forbids diluting the AR checks to cover ordinary defects.

remedy.action: In AmbienceDriver.step(), give the emitters their own LayerClock keyed on period_s and call buildGrain(this.ctx, {...e, level_db: e.level_db + bedTrimDb(bed)}, this.live.bus, this.rng, when, pl.pan, pl.gain) whenever this.ctx && this.live && pl.audible. _emit() an 'ambience_emitter' row carrying pan, gain and distance_m so that B6's stated instrument (audioLog.pan) exists at all. Pass `listener` through from Engine.ambienceCapture() so emitters appear in a measured clip. Bound period_s in tools/analysis/ambience-census.mjs: kiln declares none (silently defaulting to 20 s) and bell_buoy is 13 s, which is inside RI-AUD03's own named 'identity becomes irritation' failure.
remedy.acceptance: Perturbing any R7 emitter's level_db by +20 dB moves the LIVE-path rendered peak by more than 1 dB; ambienceLog() returns emitter rows whose pan is strictly monotonic along the 200 m transect (B6 as written, not the placement-arithmetic proxy); every declared emitter carries a period_s of at least 45 s.

secondary_observations.what: ROOT CAUSE of the builder's open anomaly (SUCCESSOR-8), found and proved. synth.js attachMod() sets the gain LFO's swing (amt.gain.value, an ADDITIVE AudioParam connection) from the pre-trim base; ambience.js buildBedContinuous() then multiplies only the STATIC gain by dbToGain(level_db)*trim. One term follows the trim, the other does not, so bed_gain_db AND level_db are both non-scalar. Proof: rendering valus-ridge across a -2.06 dB trim change gives (dLUFS, dPeak, dCentroid) = (-1.421, -0.918, -132.7 Hz) as shipped - reproducing the builder's figures to the decimal with independently written DSP - and exactly (-2.060, -2.060, 0.0 Hz) with that one node deleted.

The same bug is an audible defect, not just a calibration nuisance, and it is on the live path. At valus-ridge's trim of -15.30 dB the LFO swing is 1.547x the static gain, so the gain parameter goes NEGATIVE at every trough and the rock-flute chord phase-inverts once every nine seconds: a declared 42% tremolo running at an effective 155%. buildBedContinuous is called by both renderBedOffline and AmbienceDriver._swapLive. Fix is three lines: apply level_db and trim before attachMod, or scale amt.gain.value identically.

RI-AUD03 B2 has no SAME control. All 78 pairs are genuinely different regions, so a judge answering DIFFERENT to everything scores separation 1.000. The item ships a check that cannot fail. The pack built here adds 8 SAME catch pairs and reports false_different_rate; the item should be amended to require them.

The tool RI-AUD03 B4 names is a flag that lies. `node tools/analysis/content-stats.mjs --audio game/data/audio/ambience/` exists, accepts the flag, ignores it and the positional path, runs the generic content census and exits 0 - so a critic running the method verbatim records B4 as passing having checked none of its four assertions. Same class as the cmb-reach.mjs --verify precedent (TOOL-LOOP rule 3 item 5). Either wire --audio through to ambience-census.mjs or amend the item to name it.

The night world has never been rendered. Every capture in ambience-render.mjs is tod:'day', so six night-only L2 sublayers and every night-gated L3/L4 event are absent from all thirteen spectra, from the separation proxy, from the level gate and from the spectra sidecar region-axes now consumes. R5 (night is a different selection, not a filter) is the rule the item cares most about after R2 and no measurement in this piece has ever seen it.

A 20 s clip is almost empty and the item's own blind test depends on what is missing from it. Measured across all thirteen regions: nine fired exactly one L3 event, four fired none, and NO region fired a single L4 creature event. Western Rootlands is one of the four (wet,open,living) regions the SectionC key says must be separated by Q3's signature sound - the hide-drum - which is now an R7 emitter and therefore silent. Stone Wastes' dying Hist is genuinely well built (partials [110,164.81,220,329.63] identical to Stone Forest's chord, detune widened 4 -> 47 cents, so it is audibly the same instrument broken - AR-3 seam #2 carried in the data) and it fires zero times in 20 s.

Interiors: the framing should change. RI-AUD03 R4 MANDATES that interiors get their own bed; it forbids the low-passed exterior, which the builder correctly avoided, but silence is a third option R4 does not sanction. RI-WLD08 SectionD6, the other item judging this path, requires >=8 settlement beds and >=4 interior beds. Measured in the running world, all six named cells suppress - including helstrom-market and stormhold-street, which are settlements - against 115 interiors in the data. So walking into any town in Black Marsh drops the world to absolute silence. This is honestly declared debt, not a design statement, and not AR-2 leakage.

The stale-sidecar detector's fail-open call is JUDGED CORRECT. Every agent in the project runs region-axes and none of them owns the audio; fail-closing one of nine axes would pin unrelated pieces at zero. The builder proved it falsifiable rather than asserting it. Two improvements: the warning goes only to console.warn, which nothing aggregates - it should also land in the JSON report as a boolean a tick can read; and a bed file that merely round-trips through a formatter changes the digest and cries wolf.

B4 cannot catch the failure the item says it catches. Setting an L3 interval to a flat 15 s passes B4, because 15 is inside the item's own 8-40 s band - yet RI-AUD03's 'How we lose' names 'raises the rate to every 15 seconds' as the signature-becomes-wallpaper failure and asserts the SectionA bands are checked in B4 for exactly that reason. Four other sabotages of my own census went red; this one did not.

A third close pair the builder did not name: marauders-coast/thornmarsh at spectral distance 0.190, a (wet,open,living) versus (dry,enclosed,dead) pair that should be among the easiest in the set. The two it did name reproduce: deep-marshes/stone-wastes 0.166 and marauders-coast/salt-hills 0.174.

Instrument smell: while suppressed, getAmbienceState() still reports the exterior bed's four layer ids and voices_active 3. Only the `suppressed` field distinguishes a silent cell from a playing one, so a probe reading layers/voices alone would conclude the bed is running.

method_deviations.deviation: B2 stimulus is a mechanically derived, label-free acoustic profile of the real rendered PCM (24 band levels relative to the clip's loudest band, spectral centroid, stereo correlation, crest factor, generic transient onsets) rather than a playable .wav.
method_deviations.why: No judge available to this project has ears and there is no audio channel to one. Both members of every pair go through the identical path so the transformation cannot itself be a tell. Weaker than listening; stronger than a cosine threshold, because a judge decides rather than a fixed distance threshold.

method_deviations.deviation: B2 sampled at 32 trials (12 hardest pairs + 12 drawn at seed 22071 + 8 SAME catch pairs) rather than the full 78.
method_deviations.why: Pre-registered before any clip was rendered. The hard stratum is adversarially selected, so any separation figure from this pack is a LOWER BOUND on the full-78 number and must be reported as such, never as the full-78 B2 figure.

method_deviations.deviation: SAME catch trials added, which B2 does not specify.
method_deviations.why: B2 as written scores only the fraction answered DIFFERENT over 78 all-different pairs, so a judge that always answers DIFFERENT scores 1.000 - a probe that cannot fail. Honest caveat: because the stimulus is a time-averaged band spectrum, two recordings of one bed are nearly seed-invariant, so these catch trials are easier than a listener's would be. They detect a yes-saying judge; they do not calibrate sensitivity.

method_deviations.deviation: Three tools written mid-critique: tools/analysis/critic-w1-22-probe.mjs, tools/blind/audio-pack-b2.mjs, and a throwaway Python census used to re-derive B4.
method_deviations.why: TOOL-LOOP rule 1. RI-AUD03 B2's named tool tools/blind/audio-pack.mjs is an absence-reporter that exits 20 and has never built a pack; RI-AUD03 B4's named tool content-stats.mjs --audio silently ignores the flag. The DSP in the critic's probe is written independently of the builder's so that agreement between the two is evidence rather than a tool reporting on itself.

method_deviations.deviation: Measurements taken with 12-30 concurrent headless_shell processes and loadavg 17.1-20.5, above AGENT-PROTOCOL's cap of 8.
method_deviations.why: Every figure quoted is a spectrum, a level, a ratio or a boolean, all of which survive contention; no wall-clock figure appears in this verdict. One browser was launched per probe and the page reused.
